test_title: PYST 93: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

Sometimes you just need to stop **contemplating **over **the past** and make a decision.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Chew the cud**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Chew the cud"** means to think slowly and carefully about something over a period of time. (किसी चीज के बारे में धीरे-धीरे और ध्यानपूर्वक सोचना)

 
 
• **Example: **He sat in his chair chewing the cud, pondering over the events of the day.
 
 
 
• Sometimes you just need to stop contemplating over the past and make a decision. The idiom "Chew the cud" accurately describes the act of contemplating or thinking over something. (कभी-कभी आपको बस अतीत के बारे में सोचना बंद करने और एक निर्णय लेने की आवश्यकता होती है। "Chew the cud" वाक्यांश सोचने या किसी चीज पर विचार करने के कार्य का सही वर्णन करता है।)
 
 
• **Example: **Rather than continuously chewing the cud over past mistakes, it's better to take action and move forward.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Chew the cud**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spill the beans **(राज़ खोल देना): To reveal secret information unintentionally.

 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party planned for her.
 
 
 
• **Make no bones about **(स्पष्ट रूप से कहना): To speak directly and without hesitation.
 
 
• **Example: **She made no bones about her dissatisfaction with the service.
 
 
 
• **Tongue and cheek** (मज़ाक में): Something said in a humorous or ironic manner.
 
 
• **Example:** His tongue and cheek comments often lighten the mood in serious meetings.
